main.description: Generic JSON extract primitive — navigate a parsed-JSON object via a safe dotted path. Bridges `http.fetch` (which returns body string) and downstream nodes that need a sub-tree (e.g. `message.items` from a Crossref response). Path syntax: `a.b.c` walks objects; `a.b[2].c` walks list indices; `a.*` flattens an object's values into a list. No eval, no JSONPath/JMESPath language — defensive subset only.

json.description: Parsed-JSON source. Either a string (will be JSON.parse-d) or an already-decoded object/array.

default.description: Value to return when the path doesn't resolve. Default: null.
